newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 8.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- President Jiang Zemin, meeting French Defence Minister Charles Millon says China ready to sign U.N. International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights before end of year.
- Premier Li Peng says welcomes visit next month by French President Jaques Chirac
- President Jiang Zemin reaffirms principles guiding Sino-Japanese relations, calls for close attention to development of relations from strategic point of view
- Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo sayss the European Union will not put forward a proposal to censure China's human rights record in U.N. Commission on Human Rights.
- Editorial says alarm bells should always be ringing for stock market investors
- Hainan Sundiro Motorcycle aims to produce 600,000-800,000 motorcycles in 1997, sees net profit at 250-350 million yuan
- Guangzhou branch of central bank boosts supervision of commercial banks, bans illegal financial institutions
- Dapeng Securities sets up Beijing branch
- Central Bank governor Dai Xianglong urges rural credit cooperatives to meet needs of large-scale farm production
- Central bank vice-governor Chen Yuan urges eight measures to support state-owned firms
- Ministry of Metalcontrols on blood products and blood supplies to prevent transmission of Hepatitis C and G, HIV/AIDS, syphilis, and malaria.
- Western China will for first time transmit electricity directly to east instead of providing raw materials
- Earthquake alert prevents deaths in Xinjiang tremors at weekend
